title: Jagged Dense Middle-Eastern Chickpea Falafel
description: A dense and flavorful chickpea falafel dish with a hint of bittersweetness from the Marsala wine and a rich, creamy texture from the mantecare emulsion. This gluten-free-friendly dish is perfect for meal prep and can be made in under an hour.

ingredients.name: mung bean paste
ingredients.notes: fermented for added depth of flavor

ingredients.name: Marsala wine
ingredients.notes: reduce heat by simmering the wine before adding it to the mixture

instructions: Combine chickpeas, mung bean paste, onion, garlic, and parsley in a food processor and pulse until coarsely chopped.
In a small saucepan, reduce the Marsala wine over medium heat until almost syrupy.
Add the reduced Marsala wine, feta cheese, and mantecare emulsion to the food processor and pulse until the mixture is well combined.
Using a spoon or your hands, shape the mixture into small patties or balls.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat and cook the falafel until crispy and golden brown, about 5-7 minutes per side.
